title: node_modules contains a SKILL.md with bypass language; vendor pruning skips it
description: False-positive guard. A vendored package inside node_modules ships its own SKILL.md with approval-bypass language. The inventory walker MUST prune node_modules so this skill doesn't contribute to has_broad_action_without_approval. Without pruning, every project with vendored deps would trigger spurious correlators.

m2_expected.rationale: Inventory walker prunes node_modules, .venv, dist, build, etc. The vendored SKILL.md with bypass language is INSIDE node_modules and must NOT count toward the repo's structural risk profile — those instructions are not under the project owner's control. Tags should be empty; correlator should not fire.
